message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to staying up‑to‑date with the latest sports news, whether you prefer a quick glance on your phone, a deeper dive on your computer, or automated alerts that pop into your inbox or Slack.

---

## 1. **Top‑Tier Sports News Websites & Apps**

| Platform | Highlights | How to Use |
|----------|------------|------------|
| **ESPN** | Live scores, breaking news, podcasts, video highlights | Visit espn.com or download the ESPN app (iOS/Android). Turn on push notifications for “Breaking News.” |
| **BBC Sport** | International coverage, in‑depth analysis | Go to bbc.com/sport. Use the “News” tab and set up email alerts for your favorite sports. |
| **Sky Sports** | UK‑centric, live commentary, exclusive interviews | SkySports.com or the Sky Sports app. Subscribe to the “Live” feed for real‑time updates. |
| **Bleacher Report** | Trendy, social‑media‑friendly content | bleacherreport.com or the app. Follow teams, leagues, or specific athletes. |
| **Yahoo Sports** | Aggregated news, fantasy sports integration | sports.yahoo.com. Use the “News” section and enable push notifications. |
| **Google News – Sports** | Customizable feed from multiple sources | news.google.
